title: Omitted values for some subclasses of univalent mappings
summary: We study the range of $\operatorname{Re}\{a_2 f(z)\}$ for normalized analytic functions $f$ in the unit disk belonging to several classes of conformal mappings. As our main contribution, we introduce the class $CC_α$ of completely convex mappings of order $α$, defined by a uniform two-point starlikeness condition, and we estimate the range of $\operatorname{Re}\{a_2f(z)\}$ in terms of $α$, for all $f\in CC_α$ and $z\in \mathbb{D}$, generalizing the classical result of Fournier--Ma--Ruscheweyh, which is recovered for $α=0$.
